result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but two text elements are clipped: the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' list is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis despite having free horizontal space, and a category chip is partially visible at the right edge (expected carousel behavior). Other elements (header, promo banner, carousels, bottom nav) render correctly.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is clipped mid-glyph ('Ramen' cut off after 'Rame') even though there is unused horizontal space to its left before the rating block; no ellipsis is applied, making the text look broken.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to use the available width (e.g., flexible width with truncation only when truly needed) or apply proper single-line ellipsis truncation so the title ends cleanly instead of being cut mid-character.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the delivery fee line and title for the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') are clipped at the right screen edge; this is expected horizontal-scroll behavior but the title clipping mid-word without ellipsis can look unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Keep the horizontal scroll affordance but consider adding a subtle fade/gradient at the right edge so partially visible cards read as scrollable content rather than broken layout.
